photos.desc: Nom français : laiteron des champs. Nom anglais : field sow-thistle. Plants en fleur(capitule) de laiteron des champs, en milieu naturel (bord de route).

Stem with leaf Taxonym: Sonchus arvensis subsp. arvensis ss Fischer et al. EfÖLS 2008 ISBN 978-3-85474-187-9 Location: between Spital and Weitra, district Gmünd, Lower Austria - ca. 640 m a.s.l. Habit
Perennial sow-thistle at Freeze Out Lake, Fish and Game Refuge, July 1977.

Perennial sowthistle. For more information on identification and control, visit <a href=" http://turfweeds.cals.cornell.edu/plant/identify/170 " rel="nofollow">turfweeds.cals.cornell.edu/plant/identif
